title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant

Southampton

A great opportunity has become available for a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to join a well-established law firm at its Park Gate office in Southampton. Working as part of a busy and friendly Commercial Property team, you will provide essential day-to-day legal and administrative support to Fee Earners across a varied commercial property caseload.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting Fee Earners with a varied commercial property caseload.
- Liaising with clients and third parties, including estate agents, landlords and other solicitors.
- Opening new files and matters on the firm's Case Management system.
- Drafting correspondence, documents and precedents on behalf of Fee Earners.
- Completing ID checks for clients.
- Providing general administrative and legal support to the Property team as required.

You will ideally have:
- At least 2 years plus legal secretarial or legal assistant experience within Property.
- Experience supporting commercial property matters.
- Strong legal administration and secretarial skills.
- Experience with audio typing and digital dictation systems.
- Previous experience using a Case Management system.

What they Offer:
- Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm and in the office.
- Salary depending on experience - £26,000 - £28,000
- 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays. Increasing by 1 day per year after 5 years' service (not exceeding 30 days)
- Pension scheme.
- Discounted legal services after one year service.
- Discounted gym membership relating to the Health Cash Plan.

title: Legal Assistant - Commercial Property

title: Legal Secretary - £27k-£30k - ASAP Start
description:
ROLE: Legal Secretary

CONTRACT: Permanent

HOURS: Monday - Friday, 9am - 5pm

START: ASAP

SALARY: 28,000- 31,000

LOCATION: Emsworth

PERKS: Rare opportunity to gain experience in a reputable law firm! 25 days holiday + BHs, parking ticket loan

ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role plays a key part in the heart of the team, supporting fee earners and solicitors to deliver an exceptional client experience. Working alongside Legal Secretaries and Paralegals, you'll enjoy a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are the same, keeping matters progressing smoothly and providing first-class support within a professional and collaborative legal environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a long-term career within the legal sector. Whether you already have legal experience or are coming from a strong administrative background, the role offers the chance to develop new skills, gain exposure to legal processes and terminology, and grow your knowledge within a respected and supportive firm.

Key Responsibilities:
- Providing comprehensive administrative and secretarial support to fee earners and solicitors across a variety of legal matters.
- Preparing, formatting and amending legal documents, correspondence and reports with a high level of accuracy.
- Managing diaries, scheduling meetings and coordinating appointments for members of the legal team.
- Acting as a professional first point of contact for clients, handling enquiries and building positive relationships.
- Opening, maintaining and closing client files, ensuring all documentation is kept up to date and compliant.
- Managing incoming and outgoing post, emails and telephone calls, prioritising and directing communication as appropriate.
- Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the office through general administrative tasks and collaboration with colleagues across different departments.

About You
- Previous experience within an administrative, secretarial, PA or office support role.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and confident approach.
- High attention to detail and the ability to produce accurate work in a fast-paced environment.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook and Excel.
- Strong client service skills and the ability to build positive working relationships.
- A proactive and adaptable attitude, with a willingness to learn new systems and processes.
- Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
- Previous legal experience would be advantageous but is not essential, making this an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a career within the legal sector and gain valuable legal knowledge and experience.

title: Legal Secretary Private Client
company: Harwood Recruitment Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
I'm currently supporting a multi-office practice which provides a comprehensive range of legal services to clients they are recruiting for a Legal Secretary / Assistant to join their busy Private Client team. They invest in training and development programmes and provide a working environment, which is both supportive and challenging. Blending traditional values of personal and cost-effective advice with a modern and fresh approach we have achieved numerous accreditations and awards. .

The main role of the Private client legal secretary is to provide direct support to his/her principal to enable them to operate at optimum efficiency. This will include but will not be limited to the key responsibilities given below. The legal secretary is expected to use a high degree of self-management and initiative.

Key Objectives
- Prepare correspondence and documents using audio typing and word processing software.
- Administer filing which will include daily filing and the opening, closing, storage and retrieval of client files in accordance with the detailed procedures contained in the office manual.
- Prepare mail and enclosures for dispatch.
- Arrange for all copying to be done, in person if the office assistant is not available to undertake the task.
- Make appointments, arrange meetings and to maintain an up-to-date diary for their principal.
- Provide support to other secretaries as required.
- Provide guidance to junior and temporary secretaries when required to do so.
- Attend clients both in person and on the telephone and to provide such support in a professional and friendly manner in keeping with the firm's standards for client care.
- Undertake any specific training when required to do so and overall to have a responsibility towards self-development.

Please apply today, this is a fantastic opportunity to work for a leading law firm, offering excellent benefits and competitive salary within a friendly and supportive environment.

title: paralegal
description:
Job Title: Paralegal

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, organised and detail-oriented Paralegal to join a legal team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous legal experience who is looking to develop their skills and progress their career within a professional legal environment.

The successful candidate will provide legal and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners, assisting with case management, legal documentation, client communication and the day-to-day running of legal matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Assisting solicitors and fee earners with the management and progression of legal cases.
- Preparing, drafting and reviewing legal documents and correspondence.
- Conducting legal research and summarising findings where required.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client files and case management records.
- Liaising with clients, courts, counsel, third parties and other relevant organisations.
- Preparing bundles, schedules and supporting documentation.
- Monitoring deadlines and ensuring documents are completed and submitted on time.
- Supporting case preparation and ensuring compliance with relevant procedures.
- Providing general administrative support to the legal team.
- Maintaining confidentiality and delivering a professional standard of client care.

Requirements
- Previous experience working within a legal environment is desirable, with experience requirements depending on the level of the role.
- A law degree, LPC, SQE-related qualification or relevant legal experience would be advantageous.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- A professional and client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good IT skills and familiarity with legal case management systems would be beneficial.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will be proactive, reliable and enthusiastic about developing their legal career. They will have a strong work ethic, a willingness to learn and the ability to support a busy legal team effectively.

How to Apply

If you have the relevant skills and experience and are interested in developing your career within the legal sector, we would welcome your application.

title: Senior Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Our client is seeking an experienced Senior Conveyancing Assistant to support a busy residential property team. The successful candidate will assist with the progression of property transactions, preparing legal documentation, managing client communications and ensuring matters progress efficiently from instruction through to completion.

Key Responsibilities:
- Support residential property transactions: prepare documentation, manage client correspondence, and maintain accurate files.
- Draft contracts and transfer documents, request and review searches, and liaise with clients, lenders, estate agents, and other solicitors.
- Assist with exchange and completion processes and ensure compliance with regulatory and firm procedures.
- Manage key dates and provide proactive administrative support to keep matters progressing efficiently

Experience and Skills Requirements
- Strong experience in conveyancing support from file opening to completion.
- Excellent client care and professional communication with clients, colleagues, and third parties.
- Solid organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple matters, prioritise workloads, and meet deadlines.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy in preparing documents, maintaining records, and following compliance procedures.
- Familiarity with legal case management systems (e.g. Redbrick) and MS Office.
- Paralegal qualification preferred or equivalent practical experience in conveyancing at a senior support level.
- Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and contribute to a supportive working environment.

If you have not been contacted within 5 working days, then unfortunately on this occasion your CV has not been shortlisted.
